summary: Comprehensive testing of P1 Features (Timer, Game History, Crash Resilience) completed. All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tested for Timer config in Host Control, countdown displays in Presentation View and Player View, TIME'S UP lockout, Game History list and detail pages, and sidebar navigation. All features working correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Timer implementation uses ISO timestamps (timer_end_at) - clients compute remaining time locally using useCountdown hook
Timer is started on next_question for regular questions, and on start_answering for picture questions (after wagering)
Timer is cleared on reveal and scores phases
Game history is saved to game_history collection with full scoreboard and per-question player answers
Duplicate prevention: end_game checks if history already exists before saving
Active games are persisted to active_games collection on key state changes (create, join, next, reveal, scores)
Server startup restores active games from DB (startup_restore_games event)
useCountdown hook efficiently computes remaining seconds with 250ms interval

seed_data_creation: Created multiple test games during testing. Game history entries preserved for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 Features fully implemented and tested. Key features: 1) Timer - configurable via set-timer endpoint, presets 0/15/30/45/60/90s, timer_end_at is ISO timestamp, clients compute remaining time locally. 2) Game History - saved to game_history collection on end_game or natural finish, GET /api/game-history for list, GET /api/game-history/{id} for detail with question_results. 3) Crash Resilience - active games saved to active_games collection, restored on server restart. Test user testhost@trivia.com/Test1234! has sessions and game history available.
